hero_subtitle: We are dedicated to the rescue, protection and lifelong care of abandoned, injured and elderly cows.
about_heading: About Shree Ramkrishna Gau Raksha Sewa Samiti
about_text_1: Shree Ramkrishna Gau Raksha Sewa Samiti is a dedicated social service organization inspired by the spiritual teachings, values and selfless service principles of Lord Shri Ram and Sri Ramakrishna Paramhansa.
about_text_2: Our mission is holistic social development through selfless human service. We firmly believe that service to God is service to mankind.
about_text_3: The organization actively works in the areas of education, healthcare, rural development, women empowerment, youth development and upliftment of marginalized communities.
goal_1: Protection of helpless and abandoned cows
goal_6: Environmental protection and promotion of organic practices
ved_project_heading: Ved Divyang Shikshan Prashikshan Seva Sansthan
ved_project_text: Ved Divyang Shikshan Prashikshan Seva Sansthan is a key initiative of Shree Ramkrishna Gau Raksha Sewa Samiti. The institute aims to provide education, training and self-reliance opportunities to persons with disabilities.
ved_project_text_2: We believe that disability is not a weakness but a different ability. With proper guidance and opportunities, every individual can lead a dignified and independent life.

gau_video_desc.story_1_title: Saving the Life of an Injured Cow
gau_video_desc.story_1_text: An injured cow found on the roadside was immediately treated by our team and is now living a healthy life.
gau_video_desc.story_2_text: Many abandoned and elderly cows were given safe shelter, food and medical care at our goshala.
gau_video_desc.story_3_text: Awareness programs were organized with villagers and volunteers to promote compassion and service.
